_meta.purpose: Verify URLs + facts + prices for 18 RU catering companies (10 Moscow + 8 SPb)
_meta.methodology: z-ai web_search CLI hit sustained HTTP 429 rate limit (could not retrieve any search snippets despite ~20 min of retries). Fell back to direct curl HEAD checks for URL liveness (all 18 returned HTTP 200) + curl GET of each homepage + Python regex extraction of title, meta description, founding year claims, and prices. Official-site data is the gold standard and is actually MORE concrete than search snippets would have been.
_meta.raw_search_status: All 18 z-ai web_search calls returned HTTP 429 (rate-limited) — saved as raw files 01_novikov.json … 18_woweve.json in research_ru_v5b_raw/ for audit. No web_search data was retrievable this session.
_meta.raw_pages_dir: /home/z/my-project/scripts/research_ru_v5b_raw/pages/ (18 HTML files, one per caterer homepage)
